plan.authorization: Owner accepted the bounded provisional atlas release on 17 November 2026; publish, commit and push without an additional permission step.
plan.supersedes: Earlier candidate declarations prohibit default/publication changes. This authorization permits only the provisional publication described here, without changing historical scientific adoption gates.
plan.freeze: No model refit, new source selection, climate update, settlement relocation, or total population change. Publish the already reviewed fit and annual supply, with central and low density readings for raw/corrected climate.
checks_before_publication: Independent refreshed Earth development fit review
Independent candidate fit, application and finite population ledger
Independent annual grain and work review
checks_after_publication: Exact archived baseline and frozen scientific input hashes
Published maps and downloads trace to reviewed candidate and its own supply
Raw/corrected and central/low controls; before/after comparison
Desktop/mobile browser, search, selection, pan/zoom and downloads
plan.baseline_preservation: Before live mutation, archive each changed protected publication file and record hashes. Recheck every other protected science file. Historical review receipts remain historical; no claim that all live protected identities remain unchanged after authorized publication.
plan.cohort_boundary: New settlement maps and annual supply belong to the provisional candidate. Existing reach, trade, administration and recurrence belong to release 4 or their explicitly named older scenario; label the boundary in the atlas and do not silently assign new populations to old derived results.
assumptions: Earth checks are development comparisons, not an untouched validation pool
Density is a scenario, not a census
Five seeded realizations describe scenario sensitivity, not calibrated uncertainty
Fixed town ranks include campaign lore
Annual work-limited grain is not seasonal food/work feasibility
Warehouse capacity, access, handling staff, crop calendars and diets remain unresolved
plan.publication: Make provisional central settlements the default settlement option, retain release-4 references and publish a hosted comparison with downloadable town data. Do not rewrite adopt=false or gate.passed=false in original candidate artifacts.
